name: player-card
title: Player card
description: One pickable player, as a card: a modifier band saying what picking them is worth, a portrait, the name, a meta line and a tail. The portrait, the name and the meta line are an `identity` and are never redrawn here, so the avatar cases and the signed-out slot behave the same on a card as they do in a leaderboard row. Four states, the four specimen 3k draws: idle, `data-gs-selected` which is reversible, `data-gs-committed` which is not, and `data-gs-state` once the host settles it. Committed drops the selected marker, so one card never claims both. A settled or locked card always renders a glyph as well as a fill, and every state is in the accessible name. Performs nothing: it does not decide whether a pick is allowed, does not settle a result and reports a press without changing itself.
docs: Import `app/gamestage-primitives.css` at your root beside `gamestage-tokens.css`: the press gesture and the action face come from the shared rule sets in that file, which `@gamestage/tokens` already installs. Pass `player` as the adapter's player, or `null` for a slot nobody has filled. Pass `modifier` for the band, `meta` for the line under the name and `detail` for the tail; pass `meta` and `modifier` as strings where they should be announced, because a node cannot go into an accessible name. Pass `onSelect` to make the card itself the control, and leave it off where your own button does the picking, which is what the pick carousel does. Set `selected` while the pick is reversible, `committed` once it is not, and `state` when the result is known; the component never moves between them on its own. `locked` keeps the card and shows a padlock, `disabled` takes it away.
